label: def:local-cohomology-group
title: Local cohomology at the unit defect
html: The local cohomology group H^1_{\mathfrak{m}_1}(A) = R^1\Gamma_{\mathfrak{m}_1}(A) measures the algebraic obstruction to extending sections across the defect at z = 1. In this non-commutative setting, the derived category framework generalizes the commutative concept of principal parts supported at the singularity.
